privacy_principles.rule: Define why each category of personal data is collected and used.
Collect only the data reasonably necessary for the confirmed purpose.
Explain relevant data practices in clear, accessible language.
Provide mechanisms to correct inaccurate information where required.
Define retention and deletion requirements based on applicable obligations and business needs.
Limit data access to authorized people and systems.
Identify applicable rights and implement the processes needed to support them.
Maintain evidence of decisions, safeguards, and required approvals.

data_categories.handling: Define purpose, access, retention, and sharing.
Apply relevant heightened safeguards and jurisdiction-specific requirements.
Assess identifiability, collection purpose, vendor sharing, and applicable consent requirements.

rules: Do not collect sensitive health details in a generic contact form by default.
Do not place personal or health data in URLs, page titles, or analytics event names.
Do not use real patient records as prompts or test fixtures without approved safeguards.
Do not send sensitive data to AI services unless the service and data processing are explicitly approved.
Do not assume de-identification is effective without evaluating re-identification risk.
Escalate unclear legal bases, retention obligations, and data-sharing arrangements.
